channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Calera Eagles working toward improvement in 2026
item.description: After a 2025 campaign that was not much to remember, the Calera Eagles are aiming to make progress and have a productive 2026 season.

item.title: Calera Eagles seeking to build on 2025 success
item.description: The Calera Eagles made it to the third round of the playoffs last season and are aiming to build on that success during their 2026 campaign.

item.title: Spain Park downs Baker, Robertsdale at Southern Shootout for first wins
item.description: Spain Park earned its first wins of the season over Baker and Robertsdale at the Southern Shootout.

item.title: American Legion Post 555 to host District Oratorical Contest Feb. 21
item.description: The American Legion Matthew Blount Post 555 will host the 23rd District High School Oratorical Scholarship Contest on Saturday, Feb. 21, at the Pelham Senior Center.

item.title: Shelby County Showcase of Schools displays excellence
item.description: Shelby County Schools hosted its annual Showcase of Schools event on the morning of Thursday, Feb. 12, putting the school system’s innovative instruction options on display for the community.

item.title: Pelham City Council approves new meeting schedule, extends U.S. 31 lighting project
item.description: The Pelham City Council approved a series of infrastructure projects, adopted a new meeting schedule and formalized an employment agreement with City Manager Gretchen DiFante during its Monday, Feb. 16 meeting at Pelham City Hall.

item.title: Pelham Youth Cheer caps 2025 season with multiple first-place finishes
item.description: The Pelham Parks and Recreation youth cheer program closed out its 2025 season with a trophy case full of first-place finishes, individual awards and momentum that continues to build across every grade level.

item.title: Helena Utility Board approves rate increase
item.description: The Helena Utility Board voted to approve a rate increase at its meeting on Tuesday, Feb. 17, following a presentation on Thursday, Feb. 12. The change will go into effect in April.

item.title: Record turnout highlights Pelham Spring Soccer Clinic at Ned Bearden Stadium
item.description: Despite frigid temperatures on Monday, Jan. 12, young athletes bundled up and packed the field at Ned Bearden Stadium for the Pelham Spring Soccer Clinic, setting a new participation record for the program.

item.title: Kites & Bites to kick off spring season at Pelham City Park
item.description: March winds and mild temperatures will set the stage for one of Pelham’s most anticipated spring traditions as Pelham Parks and Recreation hosts Kites & Bites on Sunday, March 8 from 3:30 to 6 p.m. at Pelham City Park.
